quarterly_data.quarter: Applied Materials press release: Applied Materials Unveils $5 Billion EPIC Center in Silicon (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Applied unveiled its EPIC (Equipment and Process Innovation and Commercialization) Center at its Sunnyvale, California campus on Oct. 12, 2026: a $5 billion capital investment (the company notes capital spending is expected to scale over time to approximately $5 billion as customer projects commence) that it calls the world's largest facility dedicated to collaborative semiconductor process technology and manufacturing equipment R&D. The 600,000-square-foot structure houses nearly four acres of advanced cleanroom space. Founding partners are TSMC, Intel, SK hynix, Micron and Samsung Electronics; innovation partners Broadcom, Advantest, SCREEN, KIOXIA and Besi; research partners Arizona State University, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Stanford University, UC Berkeley and UCLA Samueli School of Engineering; additional companies and organizations are expected to join over time. Applied expects chipmakers to gain earliest access to next-generation materials and equipment and a faster path to volume production, and Applied to gain visibility across several generations of emerging technology challenges, informing where it directs its R&D investments and has its systems and services designed in.
